subject: October sea shipments
statement: Corvan Grain reports that its sea shipments of wheat and maize in October 2026 were 62% below the same month a year earlier.

subject: Corridor Agreement and strike
statement: The fall follows the end of the Corridor Agreement on 10 September and the strike at Orvan Grain Port that began on 14 September.
